column1: # Character voice (persona) cues and name suffixes, read by S and R. A speaker's persona is the voice of the
# most frequent cue among its lines in the scene; R passes it to G, which picks ending variants from
# data/ko/persona.tsv (old-male: 좋구먼). Levels are not changed by a voice here (spec/register.md REG-6:
# personas and 하오/하게 come with the VN stage).
#   type   first (a first-person pronoun), final (a sentence-final form), suffix (an honorific name suffix: the word
#          before it is a name, S's scene registry), auth (an authoritative or stiff voice, spec/register.md REG-14;
#          key parts joined by + must all occur, | separates alternatives of a part; value speaker: the row marks the speaker in the scene
#          (any of its lines), line: only the line itself)
#   value  persona: none rough old-male lady formal pompous archaic grand
